name: Blood for Blood

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh are cultists whom the Windshapers regard as bloody zealots. The Windshapers suspect them of slaying novices in the Highlands.
Several Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands, and the Windshapers suspect the Al'Aketh. Their creed calls for vengeance in return.
faq.q: Why are the Windshapers seeking retribution?

faq.answer: Ayessa represents the Windshapers. She directs their retribution against the Al'Aketh and collects the prayer charms taken from fallen cultists.
Al'Aketh cultists carry windstone prayer charms. Ayessa asks for them as proof that the cultists responsible for the killings have been slain.
faq.q: What are the windstone prayer charms?

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh are to the north in the Gustberry Lowlands, where they carry out their practices.
faq.q: Where can the Al'Aketh be found?

sections.body: Several Windshaper novices have been found slain in the Highlands. Proof is scarce, yet the Windshapers suspect the Al'Aketh cultists. Their zealotry makes them the chief suspects. The Windshapers' creed demands an eye for an eye, so they will not let the killings go unanswered.
sections.title: A Grim Discovery

sections.body: Ayessa calls for you to strike at any Al'Aketh you find north in the Gustberry Lowlands. She asks you to bring back the windstone prayer charms carried by the fallen cultists, as proof of their deaths. The Windshapers see this strike as an answer to the cultists' long fanaticism.
sections.title: Demands of Retribution

summary: Several Windshaper novices lie dead in the Highlands, and the Windshapers suspect the Al'Aketh. Ayessa sends you north to the Gustberry Lowlands to answer the killings and bring back the fallen cultists' windstone prayer charms.
